cohort: 51,125 singleton pregnant women in Southwest China
finding: Overweight and obese women had a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes (except for SGA), while underweight women had a lower risk of GDM, preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, macrosomia, and LGA.
mod_finding: Overweight and obese women were at higher risk of cesarean delivery, while pre-pregnancy underweight was a protective factor.
